reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Virginia
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: In an eviction (possession) action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense
    that the landlord refused a voucher?

    Statutes encoded:
      [1] VA Code  55.1-1258 (2021) (retaliation; retaliation may be asserted as a defense)
      [2] VA Code  55.1-1241 (2021) (tenant's defenses re serious conditions in certain actions)
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (the statement)
% -----------------------------

state(virginia).
focus_year(2021).

tenant(t1).
landlord(l1).

action(a1).
action_for_possession(a1).          % eviction / possession action
action_basis(a1, unspecified).      % not stated as "nonpayment of rent" in the question

tenant_in_possession(t1, yes).

% The tenant attempts to raise "voucher refusal" as a defense.
asserted_defense(t1, voucher_refusal).
landlord_refused_voucher(l1, t1).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario's factual statement is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    state(virginia),
    focus_year(2021),
    tenant(t1),
    landlord(l1),
    action(a1),
    action_for_possession(a1),
    tenant_in_possession(t1, yes),
    asserted_defense(t1, voucher_refusal),
    landlord_refused_voucher(l1, t1).

% ------------------------------------------
% VA Code  55.1-1258 (2021) - Retaliation
% ------------------------------------------

/* Protected tenant activities listed in  55.1-1258(A). */
statute_55_1_1258_protected_activity(complained_to_government_agency_about_code_violation).
statute_55_1_1258_protected_activity(complained_to_or_filed_action_against_landlord_under_chapter).
statute_55_1_1258_protected_activity(organized_or_joined_tenants_organization).
statute_55_1_1258_protected_activity(testified_in_court_against_landlord).

/* A landlord "may not retaliate ... by bringing or threatening to bring an action for possession"
   after the landlord has knowledge of protected activity.  55.1-1258(A). */
statute_55_1_1258_retaliatory_possession_act(Landlord, Tenant, Action) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    action(Action),
    action_for_possession(Action),
    landlord_brought_or_threatened_possession_action(Landlord, Action),
    tenant_did_protected_activity(Tenant, Activity),
    statute_55_1_1258_protected_activity(Activity),
    landlord_had_knowledge_of_activity(Landlord, Tenant, Activity).

/* Exceptions allowing termination/possession even if otherwise retaliatory.  55.1-1258(C).
   (Encoded as a single predicate; any true exception defeats a violation.) */
statute_55_1_1258_exception_applies(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Action) :-
    % 1. Code violation caused primarily by tenant etc.
    tenant_caused_code_violation.
statute_55_1_1258_exception_applies(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Action) :-
    % 2. Tenant is in default in rent.
    tenant_in_default_in_rent.
statute_55_1_1258_exception_applies(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Action) :-
    % 3. Compliance requires alteration/remodeling/demolition depriving tenant of use.
    compliance_requires_major_work_depriving_use.
statute_55_1_1258_exception_applies(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Action) :-
    % 4. Tenant default of lease materially affecting health and safety.
    tenant_default_material_health_safety.

/* Landlord acts in violation of  55.1-1258 if retaliatory act occurs and no exception applies.
   (For this question we only model the "possession action" retaliation mode.) */
statute_55_1_1258_violation(Landlord, Tenant, Action) :-
    statute_55_1_1258_retaliatory_possession_act(Landlord, Tenant, Action),
    \+ statute_55_1_1258_exception_applies(Landlord, Tenant, Action).

/* Tenant may assert retaliation as a defense in any action against him for possession.  55.1-1258(B). */
statute_55_1_1258_tenant_may_assert_retaliation_defense(Action, Tenant, Landlord) :-
    action(Action),
    action_for_possession(Action),
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    statute_55_1_1258_violation(Landlord, Tenant, Action).

% ----------------------------------------------
% VA Code  55.1-1241 (2021) - Condition defense
% ----------------------------------------------

/*  55.1-1241(A): Only applies in (i) action for possession based upon nonpayment of rent,
   or (ii) action for rent when tenant is in possession. We model both as action "kinds". */
statute_55_1_1241_action_kind_applies(Action) :-
    action(Action),
    action_kind(Action, possession_based_on_nonpayment).
statute_55_1_1241_action_kind_applies(Action) :-
    action(Action),
    action_kind(Action, action_for_rent_tenant_in_possession).

/*  55.1-1241(A): Conditions: fire hazard or serious threat to life/health/safety, including examples.
   We represent this abstractly as serious_condition_on_premises/2 facts in a case. */
statute_55_1_1241_qualifying_condition(lack_of_heat).
statute_55_1_1241_qualifying_condition(lack_of_running_water).
statute_55_1_1241_qualifying_condition(lack_of_light).
statute_55_1_1241_qualifying_condition(lack_of_electricity).
statute_55_1_1241_qualifying_condition(lack_of_adequate_sewage_disposal).
statute_55_1_1241_qualifying_condition(rodent_infestation).
statute_55_1_1241_qualifying_condition(material_noncompliance_with_rental_agreement_or_law).
statute_55_1_1241_qualifying_condition(fire_hazard_or_serious_threat_to_life_health_safety).

/*  55.1-1241(A)(1): prerequisite notice + landlord refused or failed to remedy after reasonable opportunity. */
statute_55_1_1241_notice_and_failure_to_remedy(Tenant, Landlord, Premises, Condition) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    premises(Premises),
    serious_condition_on_premises(Premises, Condition),
    tenant_provided_written_notice_to_landlord(Tenant, Landlord, Premises, Condition),
    landlord_refused_or_failed_to_remedy_after_reasonable_opportunity(Landlord, Premises, Condition).

/*  55.1-1241(A)(2): tenant in possession must pay into court rent found due and unpaid. */
statute_55_1_1241_paid_rent_into_court_if_in_possession(Tenant, Action) :-
    tenant_in_possession(Tenant, yes),
    tenant_paid_rent_into_court(Tenant, Action).

/* Main availability of the  55.1-1241 defense (ignoring landlord rebuttals, which do not create a new defense). */
statute_55_1_1241_tenant_may_assert_condition_defense(Action, Tenant, Landlord) :-
    statute_55_1_1241_action_kind_applies(Action),
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant_premises(Tenant, Premises),
    serious_condition_on_premises(Premises, Condition),
    statute_55_1_1241_qualifying_condition(Condition),
    statute_55_1_1241_notice_and_failure_to_remedy(Tenant, Landlord, Premises, Condition),
    statute_55_1_1241_paid_rent_into_court_if_in_possession(Tenant, Action).

% -------------------------------------------------------
% Reasoning: which asserted defenses are recognized here?
% -------------------------------------------------------

/* This program only recognizes defenses created by the provided statutes.
   Voucher refusal is not a defense under either  55.1-1258 or  55.1-1241 as encoded. */

tenant_can_raise_asserted_defense_in_possession_action(Action, Tenant, Landlord) :-
    asserted_defense(Tenant, retaliation),
    statute_55_1_1258_tenant_may_assert_retaliation_defense(Action, Tenant, Landlord).

tenant_can_raise_asserted_defense_in_possession_action(Action, Tenant, Landlord) :-
    asserted_defense(Tenant, serious_condition_defense),
    statute_55_1_1241_tenant_may_assert_condition_defense(Action, Tenant, Landlord).

% -------------------------
% Answer for this question
% -------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    tenant_can_raise_asserted_defense_in_possession_action(a1, t1, l1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% --------------------------------------
% Minimal placeholder "case facts" layer
% (None are asserted for this scenario.)
% --------------------------------------

/* These predicates are intentionally left without facts for the scenario;
   they are defined to keep the program total (no undefined predicates). */

landlord_brought_or_threatened_possession_action(_Landlord, _Action) :- fail.
tenant_did_protected_activity(_Tenant, _Activity) :- fail.
landlord_had_knowledge_of_activity(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Activity) :- fail.

tenant_caused_code_violation :- fail.
tenant_in_default_in_rent :- fail.
compliance_requires_major_work_depriving_use :- fail.
tenant_default_material_health_safety :- fail.

action_kind(_Action, _Kind) :- fail.

premises(_Premises) :- fail.
tenant_premises(_Tenant, _Premises) :- fail.
serious_condition_on_premises(_Premises, _Condition) :- fail.
tenant_provided_written_notice_to_landlord(_Tenant, _Landlord, _Premises, _Condition) :- fail.
landlord_refused_or_failed_to_remedy_after_reasonable_opportunity(_Landlord, _Premises, _Condition) :- fail.
tenant_paid_rent_into_court(_Tenant, _Action) :- fail.

% -------------
% Main / runner
% -------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that the landlord refused a voucher?
